notes.title: Quick Patch 0.2.8
notes.notes:
Hello, racers! This is a quick patch to fix one or two small problems we noticed:

-Grand Prix now goes through all four races before the trophy is presented.

-Weight effects are now fix across the board- hitting walls will cause much worse slowdown to higher weight vehicles.

-Graphical glitch where sometimes the weapon drive gauge (blue segmented bar) would sometimes remain filled even though drives have been spent has been fixed.


We've got much more coming down the pipleline, so keep a lookout!

Safe races, and happy holidays!

notes.title: Version 0.2.7 Up!
notes.notes:
Howdy! As you can tell, we're trying to increase our updating speed lately, and in that effort we've released a smaller patch fixing a few issues:

General

    The mesh cleaning error should no longer be present at the start of a race.
    -Loading Screens have been added to the game.
    -Music in races now only begins upon race countdown finishing.
    No longer need to select 'Use Color' in main menu for vehicle color change.


Weapons

    Mines: Total mines laid have been reduced from 5 mines to 3.
    Vulcan Cannon: No longer rebounds on all surfaces.


Tracks

Treen Port: Fixed a whole host of problems.

    Added and repositioned boost pads.
    Added and repositioned weapon drives.
    Fixed collision errors in various places.
    Fixed kill plain errors.
    Adjusted Terrain in some areas.
    Track now lifts slightly before the underwater tube for an easier target.


Iban Jungle:

    Increased graphical quality of Iban Jungle
    Added and positioned weapon drives
    Added and positioned boost pads


Vehicles


    Bear: Reduced Top Speed by 10 mph.


With all this, we hope your racing will be better than ever! As always, please be sure to leave feedback and suggestions as we continue on with development of Acro Storm. Thanks for anyone and everyone who chooses to share the game with friends or point us out- we can't continue development of this game without people like you!

notes.title: Version 0.2.6 Up!
notes.notes:
First, so so sorry for the lack of communication- there's little excuse for that. That said, we HAVE been working on the game as able, and so far here are the fruits of our labors- the new bikes 'Tengu' and 'Bear'!

Tengu is a Pocket-class bike, intended to be something for those that need a bit more pep, but don't mind getting a bit more risky with their driving style than the Starchaser!

Bear is something big and brutal, but not so much it can't turn a bit better than the Wildcat- if at the cost of some speed.

Not only that, we've made some other adjustments as well:

-Adjusted snow effects in Berice, things should look better now.

-Continued work on Iban Jungle in terms of assets and level design. Iban Jungle has been added to primary builds. Please note the AI for Iban is still incomplete!

-We've also adjusted the lighting and are tweaking online functionality.

There's a slew of other under the hood changes as well for better functionality and bugfixes. As usual, let us know if anything screwy pops up and we'll do our best to fix it! Thanks!

notes.title: Brief Update
notes.notes:
Hey all! So we ARE still working on the game- in fact, we can proudly say online play is functional! We just ran across a couple of gamebreaker bugs we needed to iron out, which is proving a bit dicey- particularly since one of the main programmers on the project has had some obligations he needs to deal with, which has caused some delays. That said, we're working to alleviate this issue with the rest of the team, and hopefully it won't happen again any time soon.

Seriously, we appreciate the patience, and we're horribly sorry for the delay.

notes.title: On The Recent (Here and Gone) Update
notes.notes:
Some of you may have found Acro Storm updating- unfortunately that was a slightly unfinished update; but, now that the cat's out of the bag, somewhat, we'll go ahead and tell you the details about how we intended to release it.

Put simply, it'll take us some time to test and release the new track in the full pack due to some last minute changes- the release that will come in a day (or two) is intended to have most of the new features in place, but sadly the track will be a bit longer because of them. Make no mistake, we ARE making progress on it, however, and it should be done before long. As this is the first pack, we're still ironing out development methods, and we intend on using this experience to adjust our content creation rate and timeframes so that everything can be delivered as planned.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: First Patch Incoming
notes.notes:
Okay, so some early issues should be solved here. This is the list of changes this patch should bring:

General: 
-Fixed an issue where the audio would not play in races.
-Increased Start Banner size.
-Improved distinction of main menu selections. Should now be far easier to see what is selected in menus.
-Added 'View Controls' to Options menu. You can now see the controls for the game by selecting 'View Controls' from the Options menu.
-Increased hitbox size for power tokens. Tokens should be easier to collect now.
-Fixed a glitch where the race position counter would bug out, showing incorrect race placement. Race position should now be accurate from race start to finish.

Acro Stadium:
-Added Boost Pads.
-Added new Power Tokens, adjusted placement of old ones.
-Improved road texturing.
-Adjusted AI pathing. Should not slam into walls so much.
-Adjusted Preview Image in Course Select.

Batam Gorge:
-Fixed glitch where racers could fall through geometry by hitting a specific spot early in the track.
-Adjusted lighting and textures.

Treen Port:
-Fixed glitch where racers could fall through geometry endlessly by exiting the pipe near the end of the course incorrectly.
-Adjusted textures.
-Adjusted Preview Image in Course Select.

Thanks so much for the early impressions- keep it up and hopefully nothing too horrible will happen between now and the first pack release! Remember, there'll be a lot of quality of life improvements in it, as well as bugfixes and new content!

This patch should be going up tonight. Happy New Year, folks! May your 2017 be bright!

Edit: As of this edit, patch is now live!
